method: Review 27 pending phrases, retaining inferential stance and distinct meanings of ordinary words. Add two receptive slang entries and close only the paragraphs they actually explain.
phrases: go check up on
go to see whether someone is safe or doing well
去看看……是否安好
I'll go check up on our neighbor after the storm.
暴风雨后，我会去看看邻居是否安好。
Welfare-check sense here; check up on can elsewhere imply monitoring behavior. Source expresses an expectation, not evidence anyone performed the check.
in a separate room
in a different room from the one being discussed
在另一间房里
The interviews took place in a separate room.
面试在另一间房里进行。
Separate identifies a different space; the source is a person's reported account of location, not an independently established alibi.
what do you mean
a request to clarify an intended meaning
你是什么意思；你具体指什么
What do you mean by urgent?
你说的紧急，具体是什么意思？
Use by before the term being questioned. Source imagines a possible question rather than confirming it was asked.
I could be picking up
I may be perceiving or interpreting a signal
我可能感受到或理解出……
I could be picking up the wrong tone from this email.
我可能误解了这封邮件的语气。
Could admits possible error; pick up is perceive here, not physically collect. The wrong things in source concerns interpretation, not proven events.
I haven't seen him since
I have not seen him again after the earlier event or time
从那以后我就没见过他
He left on Monday, and I haven't seen him since.
他周一离开后，我就没再见过他。
Since can stand alone when the starting event is clear. Not seeing someone does not establish where they went or what they did.
out of nowhere
suddenly or unexpectedly
突然；毫无预兆地
The question came out of nowhere.
那个问题来得很突然。
Figurative surprise; source's left out of nowhere means departure felt sudden, not that a person had no location of origin.
this is my opinion
this expresses my personal judgment rather than confirmed knowledge
这是我的个人看法
This is my opinion, but the shorter version is clearer.
这是我的个人看法，不过短一点的版本更清楚。
Marks epistemic scope; it does not make factual allegations immune from verification. Source explicitly lacks knowledge of another person's mind.
what's going on
what is happening or causing the current situation
发生什么事了；是什么情况
What's going on with the booking system?
预订系统是什么情况？
What's = what is. Go on means happen here, not continue walking; source expresses surprise about the messages.
first person POV
the perspective of the person experiencing or describing events directly
第一人称视角
The game uses a first-person POV.
这款游戏采用第一人称视角。
POV is point of view, read as letters. A chat's claim of firsthand perspective is not independent proof of observation.
this is not fake
this is asserted to be real rather than invented or counterfeit
这不是假的
The character insists, 'This is not fake.'
那个角色坚持说：“这不是假的。”
An authenticity claim, not its verification. Source paraphrases the chat's stance rather than proving the events.
at the time
during the particular past or narrated moment being discussed
当时；在那个时候
I didn't understand the instructions at the time.
我当时没理解那些说明。
Needs a contextual time reference; source attaches the lack of knowledge to when messages were sent, not forever afterward.
makes it sound like
creates an impression through wording or description
让人听起来觉得……
That sentence makes it sound like the decision is final.
那句话听起来让人觉得决定已经定了。
Impression rather than fact. The source's inference about observers remains speculative even if the expression is understood.
I don't know what's going on
I do not understand what is happening in the situation
我不知道是什么情况
I don't know what's going on with the schedule.
我不知道日程安排是什么情况。
Embedded what's going on retains subject-first structure. Source extends it to another person's mind, marking lack of knowledge of intentions.
not detailed in
not described specifically in the named document or account
未在……中详细说明
The extra steps are not detailed in the guide.
指南没有详细说明额外步骤。
Detailed is a past participle meaning described in detail. Source distinguishes two lawsuits; absence from one does not mean absent from all records.
right now
at this very moment in the relevant context
就在此刻；现在
I can't talk right now, but I'll call later.
我现在没法说话，稍后会打电话。
Right intensifies now. In quoted chat it is message-time, not the time of this review; it does not resolve the adjacent sexual slang.
absolutely zero
none at all, with strong emphasis
完全没有；一丁点儿都没有
We have absolutely zero spare copies.
我们一份备用副本都没有。
Emphatic zero can modify uncountable recollection as in source. No memory of an event is not a claim that the event never occurred.
in doing so
by performing the action just described
这样做就……；在这样做的过程中
She checked the list and, in doing so, found an error.
她检查了清单，并在这个过程中发现了一个错误。
So refers to a preceding action, not just any behavior. Source's claim of organizing an assault is attributed to the quoted filing.
it doesn't appear
the available evidence does not seem to show something
看起来似乎并没有……
It doesn't appear that the file was saved.
看起来文件似乎没有保存。
It doesn't appear that + clause, or to + verb. Appearance is limited evidence, not certainty about unseen details.
no recollection
no memory of a particular event
完全没有记忆；不记得
She has no recollection of receiving the letter.
她不记得收到过那封信。
Have no recollection of + noun/-ing. More formal than don't remember; do not infer deception from memory absence.
what in the world
an emphatic expression of surprise, confusion or distress
到底怎么回事；究竟……（加强惊讶或疑惑）
What in the world happened to this room?
这个房间到底怎么了？
In the world intensifies a question, not a request for geographical location. Source's short exclamation expresses reaction to the picture.
barely made a dent in
made only a very small amount of progress through something large
对……才处理了一点点
We've barely made a dent in the backlog.
积压任务我们才处理了一点点。
Figurative progress, not physical damage. In source it concerns how little of the lawsuit has been discussed, not minimization of harm.
make their way up
move or travel to a higher or upstairs location
往上走；上楼去
The guests make their way up to the meeting room.
来宾们往楼上的会议室走去。
Make one's way means go, not create a road; up is directional here, with the destination supplied by context.
on the other side
at the opposite side of a space or object
在另一边；在对面
The entrance is on the other side of the building.
入口在建筑的另一侧。
Needs a reference space if not already clear. Source means across the room, not an opposing opinion or an afterlife euphemism.
she feels like
she has the subjective impression that something is so
她觉得；她感觉好像……
She feels like she needs more time to decide.
她觉得自己需要更多时间作决定。
Feel like + clause is an impression; feel like + -ing can mean want to do something. Source uses the impression of having no escape.
on the other side of the room
across the room from the person or reference point
在房间另一边
My bag is on the other side of the room.
我的包在房间另一边。
Spatial distance, not outside the room. Source phone location is reported by Jane, without supplying a floor plan.
there's no way for her to
the circumstances leave her no available means to do something
她没有办法……
There's no way for her to upload it without access.
没有访问权限，她无法上传它。
For + person + to + verb. Source says she feels like, preserving her experience rather than an external proof that every possible exit was impossible.
I have no recollection
I do not remember the event being discussed
我完全不记得
I have no recollection of signing this form.
我完全不记得签过这张表。
Formal memory disclaimer; add of + noun/-ing for the event. Whatsoever in source strengthens the negative, not the factual content.
legit
genuine or credible, informally
真的；可信的（口语）
The offer looks legit, but let's verify the sender.
这项优惠看起来像真的，不过我们先核实发送者。
Short for legitimate. Source's must be legit is part of the narrator's imagined reading of a message, not authentication.
hammered
very drunk, informally
喝得烂醉的（俚语）
The novel describes a guest as hammered after the party.
小说把一位宾客描写为聚会后喝得烂醉。
Informal intoxication adjective, not physically struck with a hammer. Source is a person's interpretation of her appearance in a photograph, not a measured alcohol level.
segments: Legit and the since time boundary are now explicit. I'm reading this as frames an imagined interpretation, because offers that imagined speaker's reasoning, and it does not prove location or actions.
The intoxication slang is now explicitly defined; I look makes this the quoted person's impression of the image rather than a measured clinical state.
Intoxication slang and the women's campus-organization label are covered. Repeated look is a spoken repair, and the description is self-attributed rather than a generalization about all members.
